content.summary: The framing defines the potentially ambiguous rank convention explicitly as exact uniformity. Its three-sunflower definition agrees with the inspected formal predicate: three distinct family members, equal pairwise intersections, and no nonempty-core restriction. The distinction between local unresolved exclusion and the externally reported computer-assisted result is plainly stated. I verified the manuscript byte hash and canonical snapshot hash. This round makes no text-reuse or global originality finding.

findings.statement: The phrase 'ordered-free pairs of members' in the support-56 argument is nonstandard; the displayed A<B sum denotes unordered pairs of distinct members.
findings.disposition: Replace 'ordered-free pairs' with 'unordered pairs of distinct members' for consistent counting terminology.

checks.method: Compared the conventions paragraph with F01 SunflowerLean/Basic.lean lines 19–27 and inspected the P/W counting paragraph.
checks.observation: The formal family is a Finset, has cardinality three, and permits any finite core; the prose preserves these requirements. The counting identity is understandable, with one terminology repair recommended.
